records.hypothesis: A phase review must retain a local immutable capture of any input whose live program page is expected to change later.

records.evidence: P4 packet locator review and the planned P5 phase transition; no source artifact had yet changed when the risk was identified.
records.result: The P4 packet now points to p4-inputs/p5-component-ablation-plan-v1.md and can remain immutable while P5 progresses.
records.limitation: The capture preserves P4's planning input only; it is not a P5 execution receipt.
